response.overview: It's the chaotic start of a new semester. A strange rumor begins spreading through Class 2-3: a 'ghost' has been sneaking around, stealing things. Not a thief — a ghost. And Daeseok played no small part in that, spreading exaggerated stories to make sure no one suspected him. Now the rumor has taken a darker turn: the ghost is hurting people, too. Their classmate Gichan keeps showing up with fresh cuts on his face, but claims he can't remember how — and stops talking about it altogether. Then Minsu hears something he doesn't want to believe: that his hero, Gitae, might be the ghost. Unable to accept it, he ends up defending the very thing he should be questioning. What choice will Minsu make?
response.title: 영웅은 없다
